scope: One fixed-guitar035 native environment; unchanged production helper and original 15s thumb-only finite probe. Not learned policy performance or contact-pair pressure.
base_scope_notice: Original report.json is untouched and retains inherited free-guitar wording; actual fixed mode/readback is recorded here.

helper_contract.patch: thumb-specific source -x distal/+z flexion/-y inward-side triangles; same sampled point and outward normal
helper_contract.region: face-referenced physical playing-neck1 rear, central 50% width, work-fret center Gy +/-0.04m clipped to neck1; unused OBJ vertices and headstock transition excluded
helper_contract.gap: signed outward rear-plane distance; maximum quality at0..0.003m
helper_contract.penetration: smoothstep from0 at-0.001m to1 at0; zero below-0.001m
helper_contract.contact_candidate: same sample signed gap[-0.001,0.0005]m, region excess<=1e-6m, facing>=0.1 and thumb3 rear-normal net load>=0.01N
helper_contract.reward: 0.01/s geometric quality +0.01/s same-point geometric quality times binary contact candidate; larger loads give no extra reward
helper_contract.net_load: relu(thumb3 native resultant force in guitar coordinates dot unit source rear normal); absent/nonfinite input disables contact candidate
helper_contract.selection: maximum rate, then maximum geometric quality, then nearest finite-region point; first sample only at exact distance tie
helper_contract.integration: rate only; caller integrates completed physics dt and failure suppression
helper_contract.limitation: finite source samples, not cooked collision geometry, anatomical annotation, contact-pair or pressure certification

diagnostic_contract.duration: completed physics endpoint count/240; thumb completed control endpoint count/60
diagnostic_contract.exclusions: overlapping per-finger seconds; never sum exclusions as disjoint time
diagnostic_contract.standby_masks: actual v5 score-only per-finger active union; release0.05s and0.1s fade; next preparation0.35s and0.1s fade; direct/partial/full gap recovery; finite geometry required
diagnostic_contract.idle_angles: gate-weighted valid geometric flexion; denominator per joint valid gate-weighted seconds
diagnostic_contract.press_angles: own assigned press..end inclusive, valid geometric flexion; denominator per joint valid seconds
diagnostic_contract.standby: actual inverse-quadratic helper per_finger_rate integrated at240Hz; weighted reward excludes entire failed control tick exactly as environment
diagnostic_contract.initial_quality_decline: quality below reset reference minus1e-6; completed240Hz fullgate==1 samples before own first press-2; absent fingers whole song; invalid reset/current angles excluded; no sample means evaluableFalse
diagnostic_contract.recovery: fixed own-note-union gaps: previous end+0.05s release+1.0s provisional return budget through next press-0.35s; initial start1.05s, final end song duration; windows>=0.5s evaluated at80% planned occupancy; no policy gate in denominator; not a proven return-time guarantee
diagnostic_contract.gate_runs: actual gate>0 and gate==1 completed240Hz endpoint runs; lengths/counts/band occupancy include ongoing runs; thresholds0.5/1/3s; no dynamic per-tick trace
diagnostic_contract.wrist: absolute nearest-box delta by live guitar-local Gx/Gy/Gz; inclusive inside region; physics endpoint samples
diagnostic_contract.thumb: minimum Euclidean distance from existing finite source thumb2/3 support vertices to face-referenced playing-neck1 rear facets (outward normal Gz < -0.5); excludes unused OBJ vertices and headstock transition; rear-side compatible permits signed plane gap >= -1 mm
diagnostic_contract.thumb_limitation: legacy60Hz support vertices have no normals; shared thumb_support240Hz uses same-point patch position/normal and selected-point signed gap; neither certifies native contact pairs, pressure, sound, full mesh penetration or cooked collision geometry
diagnostic_contract.thumb_support: shared helper rate at240Hz:0.01/s geometric quality plus0.01/s same-point quality times binary contact candidate; actual weighted payout uses completed-control failure suppression, approach weight and explicit multiplier0(off)/1(on); native net force and rear-normal load are resultant proxies, never pressure or contact-pair certification
diagnostic_contract.thumb_contact_candidate: shared selected point signed gap[-0.001,0.0005]m, finite central neck-rear region, facing>=0.1, native thumb3 rear-normal load>=0.01N; force magnitude above threshold gives no further reward
diagnostic_contract.thumb_normal_load: helper relu(native thumb3 resultant in guitar coordinates dot unit rear normal); mean denominator is helper normal_load_valid completed physics seconds
diagnostic_contract.thumb_nearbutunloaded: near_geometry and normal_load_valid with rear-normal load<0.01N; excludes invalid loads and does not imply a known body pair
diagnostic_contract.extreme_combinations: 240Hz geometric flags per finger: MCP<-20deg and PIP/DIP>60deg; MCP/PIP>75deg and DIP<10deg; DIP-PIP>50deg. Flags overlap and are diagnostics only; idle means outside own press..end, independent of B gate

guitar_representation.proxy_collision_policy: G:thumb_support_proxy and G:pluck_range retain visuals and their original mass/COM/inertia contribution, but both geoms have contype=conaffinity=0. Intentional difference: their original possible chair/ground contacts are fully excluded. Original logical39 markers and source properties retained.

scene.state_setter_scope: Episode boundaries only; human DOF and free guitar root

hand_collision.external_pair_preservation: Checked against actual compound-guitar and chair filters; the two source guitar proxies have no physical shape in the GPU compound asset.
